systems.system: MTN Nigeria ISO 27001:2013 information security management system certificate (ISMS/R234/0006)
systems.country_label: ISO 27001 ISMS certificate of registration, MTN Nigeria Communications Limited, Ojota and Ikoyi data centres, Lagos

note: The certificate was issued by Certification Partner Global, a Dubai-based certifier, against an international standard, and names no Nigerian standards body or in-country accredited certifier; a certificate from a certifier abroad is not a fact, so it is recorded as a system of class other.
